title: Meet the knight
objectives: Understand the knight's L-shaped move and that it can jump over pieces

steps.text: The knight moves in an L-shape: two squares in one direction, then one square to the side. It's the only piece that can jump over other pieces.

steps.prompt: Move the knight in an L-shape to any of its eight possible landing squares.

hints.text: Move two squares one way, then one square to the side.
There are eight possible landing squares from here.
The knight hops from e4 to f6.

feedback.default: That's not an L-shape — two squares one way, then one square to the side.

steps.prompt: A knight can jump over pieces that are in its way.

feedback.default: The knight is the only piece that can hop over anything in between.
